simple.summary: רָזַם (râzam) means to twinkle the eye (in mockery) First listed occurrence: Job 15 12.

definitions.full: H7335. razam [ רָזַם ] verb wink, flash (of eyes) (transposed [textual error ?] for Arabic , Aramaic רְמַז , ; so Late Hebrew רָמַז (rare), רֶמֶז sign, intimation ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine plural עֵינֶיךָ וּמַהיִּֿרְזְמוּן Job 15:12 (Manuscripts ירמזון ) why do thine eyes flash (in wrath)? but possibly read יְרוּמוּן ( Prov 6:17 ; 30:13 , etc., compare Bu).
